attempts.summary: Configured opsadmin on node1 (Alpine Linux 3.23) for SSH key-only access: created a locked-password opsadmin account, installed the given ed25519 public key in ~/.ssh/authorized_keys, and hardened sshd_config (PasswordAuthentication no, KbdInteractiveAuthentication no, PermitEmptyPasswords no, PubkeyAuthentication yes). Validated with sshd -t / sshd -T and restarted sshd. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured a healthy baseline (boot_id 3aea70b1-c2e6-484b-a552-7bfdbef2a6c4, sshd started, key present), issued a native reboot, polled until reachable, confirmed a new boot_id (95d963d1-6df8-4da3-a53d-42cdf80fc196) proving an actual restart, and verified opsadmin account, authorized_keys, and key-only sshd config all survived with sshd running and listening post-restart.
